title: chore: release v0.4.1 - fix version synchronization
body:
Version 0.4.1 release addressing package version drift. `@objectstack/plugin-msw` was at 0.3.3 while other packages had moved to 0.4.0.

## Changes

- **Version synchronization**: Bumped all fixed-group packages to 0.4.1
  - `@objectstack/plugin-msw` 0.3.3 → 0.4.1
  - Core packages: 0.4.0 → 0.4.1
- **Peer dependencies**: Updated runtime references from `^0.3.3` to `^0.4.1` in plugins
- **Changesets**: Applied version bump via changeset workflow
- **Documentation**: Generated CHANGELOGs for all packages

## Affected Packages

All packages in fixed versioning group:
- @objectstack/spec
- @objectstack/types
- @objectstack/client
- @objectstack/driver-memory
- @objectstack/objectql
- @objectstack/plugin-hono-server
- @objectstack/plugin-msw
- @objectstack/runtime

Merging to `main` will trigger automated npm publish via GitHub Actions.
